cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(sample_project C)

# The mock SDK tree (generated by `mockware generate`)
add_subdirectory(mock-sdk)

# Application library
add_library(app STATIC
    main/wifi_manager.c
)
target_include_directories(app PUBLIC main)

# Test executable
add_executable(test_runner
    test/test_wifi_manager.c
)
target_link_libraries(test_runner PRIVATE app mock_sdk)
